overlay_engine_architecture.sqlite_bundle_invariant: PRAGMA query_only = ON preserved; 0 writes issued to topology.sqlite

harness_execution.name: Dynamic Lift Closure & Weather Reroute Harness

test_cases.name: testDirectRouteUnderNormalConditions
test_cases.assertion: Verifies baseline route from village_mountain_village to everetts_8800 selects direct Path A via lift_ramcharger (240s).

test_cases.name: testWindHoldDetour
test_cases.assertion: Applies windHold to lift_ramcharger and verifies clean detour via lift_swift_current -> trail_andesite_connector in 0.092ms (< 5.0ms budget) with PRAGMA query_only = ON untouched.

test_cases.name: testReopenedLiftRestoresPrimaryPath
test_cases.assertion: Verifies setting lift_ramcharger back to .open (and calling resetAllOverlays()) immediately restores direct Ramcharger 8 routing.

test_cases.name: testDeltaJSONPayloadParsing
test_cases.assertion: Ingests both Liftie live telemetry JSON and Cloud Run delta envelopes via applyOverlayDelta(jsonPayload:), verifying status/grooming overrides and live route switching.

test_cases.name: testHardExclusionStatusesAndSoftGroomingOverrides
test_cases.assertion: Asserts closedPatrol, windHold, and mechanicalHold return nil from calculateCost, and effectiveGrooming (.ungroomed, .powder, .moguls, .groomed) overrides base piste multipliers.

test_cases.name: testConcurrentThreadSafeOverlayAccess
test_cases.assertion: Executes 200 concurrent read/write operations across DispatchQueue.concurrentPerform with zero data races under Swift 6 StrictConcurrency.

harness_execution.pass_criteria: testWindHoldDetour() cleanly redirects route around Ramcharger 8 within 5ms of overlay application without mutating SQLite.

content_harvesting.sublines: Dynamic Graph Edge Masking in Memory: Sub-100-Microsecond Alpine Weather Rerouting
talking_points: Decoupling immutable seasonal cartography (`topology.sqlite` opened with `PRAGMA query_only = ON` and 1-year CDN caching) from volatile 5-minute weather holds using an `NSLock`-guarded in-memory `[String: DynamicStatusOverlay]` overlay table.

Supporting both hard topological pruning (`.windHold`, `.closedPatrol`, `.mechanicalHold` -> `nil` edge cost) and soft surface overrides (`effectiveGrooming: .moguls` applying a 5.0x penalty atop base groomed cruisers) inside `CirqueGraphSolver.calculateCost`.
Re-evaluating multi-criteria Dijkstra detours from Mountain Village around a wind-held Ramcharger 8 via Swift Current 6 in 0.092 milliseconds (54x faster than the 5.0ms target budget).
